## How they got there
Borussia Dortmund reached the 2023-24 final as a runner-up, ultimately losing to Real Madrid with a score of 0-2. Their journey through the knockout stages was supported by a pre-season UEFA club coefficient of 86.0 points, placing them in the 75th percentile among that season's teams and the 65th percentile historically. They maintained an average of 1.83 points per game, ranking in the 69th percentile for both their specific season and all Champions League participants since 2011-12. Their defensive resilience was notable, conceding only 9.8 opponent shots per game, a figure that sits at the 48th percentile against peers.

## Would the model have picked them?
Despite reaching the final, the predictive model would likely not have selected Dortmund as a primary favorite. The model assigned an 8.9% probability of reaching the final, which is notably lower than the base rate of 12.5% for any random knockout team. This placed Dortmund at rank 8 among the 16 teams in the season's knockout phase. The model's expected stage was calculated at just 0.38, indicating a prediction closer to elimination before the quarter-finals rather than a deep run. While their high long pass percentage of 13.7% and shots per game of 10.0 provided positive pushes, these were outweighed by significant negative factors in their attack volume and goal difference.

## Weak spots
The model identified several statistical areas that dragged the prediction down. Most significantly, their attacks per game stood at 39.8, contributing -0.19 to the expected stage despite a neutral 51st percentile historically. Their goal difference of 0.5 per game also acted as a negative signal with a -0.16 contribution. Furthermore, Dortmund's passing volume was low, averaging only 400 passes per game (18th percentile all-time), which resulted in a -0.13 penalty. They struggled to convert chances, with a shot conversion rate of just 11.7%, and their possession was limited to 44.8%. Additionally, allowing 3.7 opponent shots on target per game highlighted defensive vulnerabilities that the model penalized heavily.

Quote every number exactly as it appears in the facts, with the same rounding. Do not introduce players, managers, matches, events or numbers that are not in the facts. Percentiles compare a team with other Champions League teams: 90 means higher than 90% of them. For stats marked '(lower is better)', a LOW percentile is good. SHAP contributions are measured in knockout stages: +0.30 means the stat pushed the model's expected stage up by 0.30 of a round. Write plain markdown without tables.
